title: Handling of network rejection not due to congestion control

entities.name: 5GS session management reject message
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject a 5GS session management procedure, containing back-off timer and re-attempt indicator.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Timer value included in 5GS session management reject message to regulate UE retry intervals for specific 5GSM cause values.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Indicator included in 5GS session management reject message to specify whether UE can re-attempt procedure in S1 mode after inter-system change.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: 5GS session management procedure for establishing a PDU session, subject to back-off timer restrictions when rejected.

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: 5GS session management procedure for modifying an existing PDU session, subject to back-off timer restrictions when rejected.

entities.name: 5GSM cause values triggering back-off timer
entities.description: Specific 5GSM cause values (excluding congestion-related causes) that trigger network to include back-off timer in reject message.

entities.name: Re-attempt in S1 mode allowed condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is allowed to re-attempt session management procedure in S1 mode after inter-system change.

entities.name: UE blocked from sending 5GSM requests
entities.description: Behavior where UE is prevented from sending 5GSM requests for specific combinations during back-off timer duration.

entities.name: High priority access exemption
entities.description: Exception allowing UE configured for high priority access to initiate 5GSM procedures even when back-off timer is running.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session exemption
entities.description: Exception where back-off timer does not affect UE's ability to request emergency PDU sessions.

relations.description: 5GS session management reject message contains back-off timer value IE.
5GS session management reject message contains re-attempt indicator IE.
Back-off timer inclusion is guarded by specific 5GSM cause values (excluding congestion causes).
Active back-off timer establishes that UE is blocked from sending 5GSM requests for specific combinations.
Back-off timer applicability scope is guarded by re-attempt indicator condition.
High priority access exemption establishes that UE can bypass blocking from back-off timer.
Emergency PDU session exemption establishes that UE can request emergency sessions despite back-off timer.
PDU session establishment procedure can be rejected by 5GS session management reject message.
PDU session modification procedure can be rejected by 5GS session management reject message.
